# Sessionplan

> Sessionplan (sessionplan.de) is a free, browser-based workshop timeline planner. No account, no backend, no cloud sync. Data lives entirely in the URL hash and localStorage. German-first product; English content available under /en/.

Sessionplan helps facilitators, trainers, Scrum Masters, teachers and event managers plan workshops, trainings, retrospectives, lessons, webinars, events, and other time-structured sessions on a visual drag-and-drop timeline with automatic time calculation.

Key facts:
- 100% free, no subscription, no hidden costs
- No sign-up or account required — open and use immediately
- All data stays locally in the browser (URL hash for sharing, localStorage for temp saves)
- Visual timeline: blocks with duration, color-coded by type, automatic start/end calculation
- Drag & drop reordering — cascades timestamps automatically
- Live Mode: tracks current block and remaining time during a running session
- Groups and breakout sessions for parallel tracks
- Block library: save and reuse frequently used elements
- Templates: pre-filled sessions for common formats
- Share via link (compressed URL hash), JSON export/import
- Free alternative to SessionLab

## Core pages

- [Home / Planner](https://sessionplan.de/): Start the planner directly — empty canvas, no setup required
- [Planner Modes](https://sessionplan.de/landing-pages): Overview of all usecases of the planner app
- [Blog](https://sessionplan.de/blog): Articles on workshop facilitation, Scrum, teaching, and event planning

- [Sitemap](https://sessionplan.de/sitemap.php): Full sitemap for search engines

## Templates

- [Starfish Retrospektive](https://sessionplan.de/templates/starfish-retro): Retro mit 5 Aktionskategorien: Start, Stop, Continue, More of, Less of
- [Sailboat Retro](https://sessionplan.de/templates/sailboat-retro): Segelboot-Metapher: Wind (Antrieb), Anker (Bremsen), Riffe (Risiken)
- [4Ls Retro](https://sessionplan.de/templates/4ls-retro): Liked, Learned, Lacked, Longed For
- [Mad-Sad-Glad Retro](https://sessionplan.de/templates/mad-sad-glad-retro): Emotionale Retrospektive nach Gefühlston
- [Timeline Retro](https://sessionplan.de/templates/timeline-retro): Chronologische Sprint-Retrospektive
- [Sprint Planning](https://sessionplan.de/templates/sprint-planning): Agiles Sprint Planning Meeting
- [Intensiv-Workshop](https://sessionplan.de/templates/intensiv-workshop): Vorgefertigtes Ganztages-Workshop-Template
- [Management Offsite](https://sessionplan.de/templates/management-offsite): Strategisches Führungs-Offsite (2 Tage)
- [1-2-4-All](https://sessionplan.de/templates/1-2-4-all): Liberating Structure zur Ideengenerierung
- [Impromptu Networking](https://sessionplan.de/templates/impromptu-networking): Strukturierter Beziehungsaufbau in Kurzgesprächen
- [15% Solutions](https://sessionplan.de/templates/15-percent-solutions): Identifikation sofort umsetzbarer Maßnahmen
- [25/10 Crowd Sourcing](https://sessionplan.de/templates/25-10-crowd-sourcing): Schnelle Priorisierung durch Crowd-Bewertung
- [Troika Consulting](https://sessionplan.de/templates/troika-consulting): Peer-Beratung in Dreiergruppen
- [TRIZ](https://sessionplan.de/templates/tritz): Kreative Problemlösung durch Umkehrdenken
- [What, So What, Now What?](https://sessionplan.de/templates/what-so-what-now-what): Reflexionsmethode in drei Schritten
- [DnD Ambush Session](https://sessionplan.de/templates/dnd-session-ambush): 3-Stunden D&D-Session vorgeplant
